entities.summary: Mikhail Dmitrievich Ryumin Михаил Дмитриевич Рюмин was a Soviet security officer and deputy head of the Soviet MGB who engineered the "Doctors' Plot" in 1952–1953. After the death of Joseph Stalin, his successors dismissed the case and had Ryumin arrested and executed.
